name: Interlock/InTr Boundary Admission
purpose: Admit one manifest-bound ingress at an existing Interlock/InTr boundary by validating source, destination, operation, payload/envelope integrity, applicable standing, and exact boundary identity before any downstream transition is allowed.
trigger: a governed operation reaches an existing Interlock/InTr ingress boundary
scope: one ingress attempt on one existing organization/system boundary
reuse_instructions: Reuse the existing Interlock/InTr boundary and protocol. Do not create a listener, scheduler, credential authority, WorkerCoordinator, or provider-specific governance plane. Provider/framework adapters may translate into the normalized envelope but cannot replace admission authority.
